title: Faults: close the remainder
description: The open faults after P19, worked to completion.
desiredOutcome: F230, F231, F232's broad half and BUG-6 are each either fixed with a red-first proof, or closed with the evidence that settles them - none left as a sentence.
summary: F230, F232's broad half, F239's general half and F242 are fixed and proven red; BUG-6 is closed as not reproducible with four refuted hypotheses; F231 is sized from an estimate to a measurement.

tasks.title: F230: the dirt window gets a clock the writer owns

outcome.summary: The dirt window is three rungs, narrowest first: this writer's own previous look, else the session's earliest look, else the shared file mtime. Rung 3 alone was F230 - every agent rewrites that file, so a peer agent's pass moved a peer session's window. os2c/os2d reproduce it in two runs differing by one call; red from both ends.

tasks.title: F232 broad + F239 general: an exemption's REASON is checked against what the other side runs

outcome.summary: exemption_reason_drift: a CI step that COMPARES a committed file while running an exempted script must have a reason naming a local gate that exists. The comparison is the discriminator - four of five exempted scripts only read a committed path. revisit_trigger_drift: a REVISIT trigger naming a panel surface the panel now edits has fired; three more had, unread. Both proven red and quiet.

tasks.title: F231: prove-gates derives its file set instead of listing it

outcome.summary: F231 sized from an estimate to a measurement: 15 lints owe 30 verified mutation rows, one was a misnamed formatter (fixed: render_violations -> render_budget_findings), one is a rule with no caller (F242), and the obvious narrowing was measured wrong. The walk was reverted so prove-gates stays green; all of it is in _gate_sources' docstring.

tasks.title: BUG-6: reproduce against real data or close it with the evidence

outcome.summary: BUG-6 does not reproduce. Four hypotheses driven in a real browser and all refuted, including the two the report itself offered. Closed as wontfix/not-reproducible with the evidence in its notes, so a fresh sighting reopens it knowing what is already ruled out.

verifiedBy: browser probe: 3 viewports, DOM order and painted position

tasks.title: F242: the CRLF rule is applied, not merely asserted
tasks.description: cr_violations had no caller outside its own suite - the rule was stated and never applied, and its docstring claimed two callers it did not have. ua8b asks it live over UI_ASSETS; ua8c asserts that set is real.

outcome.summary: ua8b asks cr_violations live over UI_ASSETS and ua8c asserts the set is real; the docstring stops claiming callers it does not have. Proven red by one CRLF in a shipped asset.

tasks.title: F231: prove-gates derives its file set, and the remainder is paid
tasks.description: The source set becomes a walk over scripts/, hooks/ and tools/. The 15 lints that arrive owe a RED row and an ALLOW row each - 30 verified mutations - and the coverage rule stays red until the last of them lands.

outcome.summary: _gate_sources() is a walk over scripts/, hooks/ and tools/, and the 15 lints it derives each carry a RED row and an ALLOW row. Both tables run clean over the live tree; six rows named a case the mutation did not move and were corrected against the run rather than against the reading.
